description.ja: 『ドラゴンボール超』より「ジレン」がFigure-rise Standardにラインアップ！最強の戦士を組み立てろ！
description.en: "Jiren " from " Dragon Ball Super" is now available in the Figure-rise Standard lineup! Assemble the strongest warrior!

description.ja: • マッスルビルドシステムにより第11宇宙最強戦士の超フルパワーを体感できる！
description.en: • With the muscle build system, you can experience the super full power of Universe 11's strongest warrior!
• Two types of facial expression parts are included.

description.ja: • バトル演出を盛り上げるエフェクトパーツと各種ハンドパーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with effect parts and various hand parts to enliven the battle performance.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ（左右）×各3種
accessories.en: Hand parts (left and right) x 3 types each
